supported_diagnosis: Material mistranslations are present in complete short inputs that finish normally with valid expected structure. Missing input context, output truncation, or JSON parsing is not sufficient to explain these failures.
limits: These observations locate a semantic generation failure; they do not distinguish training data, quantization, decoding or instruction-following as the ultimate cause. Valid schema and token presence cannot certify actor/role relationships or lexical sense.
experiment_hypothesis: Test one publisher-supported same-model thinking/sampling profile, with production output/context limits unchanged. No fresh validation or production code edits.
